segments.text: Mother is drying the dishes, but the water is flowing out over the sink on the floor.

segments.speaker: PAR
segments.text: It's a pretty day outside. Lots of flowers.

segments.speaker: PAR
segments.text: There are three dishes left to wash. She's standing in the water.

segments.speaker: PAR
segments.text: getting into the cookie jar. The boy's up there on the stool, and it's almost falling over. He's got one cookie in his hand. He's handing it to the little girl, and he's getting another one out of the cookie jar. Did you say action is going on?

segments.speaker: PAR
segments.text: kind of... Looks like she's trying either to be quiet or she's laughing.
